job.title: Platform Engineering Lead
job.pay_full: $124,600 – $148,200 a year base pay, with a 15% annual incentive reference value

details.about: A hands-on engineering leader in The Coca-Cola Company's new platform services organization, responsible for end-to-end delivery of a MarTech platform or major component, such as the Consumer Data Platform or the global CIAM solution, Global Access Management. The role reports to the Director, MarTech Product Development.
duties: Lead end-to-end delivery of a MarTech / AdTech platform or component while writing critical code
Manage and grow a team of 6 to 10 in-house and vendor engineers
Turn architecture and product strategy into engineering plans for globally distributed teams
Set engineering standards and AI repository guardrails
Drive developer velocity through AI-assisted development, automation and streamlined CI/CD
Improve observability, incident response and reliability practices (SRE/SLOs)
Apply data and AI patterns such as vector search and RAG where they add value
needs: 5+ years of professional software engineering, including 2+ years leading or managing engineers
Expert-level JavaScript / TypeScript, plus strong production experience with systems-level languages
Deep architecture expertise: event-driven, API-first, distributed-systems reliability and modern data platforms
Strong DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CDK), including release engineering and CI/CD
Experience leading globally distributed teams of in-house and vendor talent
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or related field; an equivalent combination of education, training and experience is also considered
nice: AI-enabled engineering: automation and AI-assisted / agentic workflows with security and quality boundaries
details.benefits: Base pay $124,600 – $148,200 a year; it may vary by geography, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. The annual incentive reference value is 15%. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.
notes: Coca-Cola will not offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US full time
